Methods for jfs objects

jfs-methods.Rd

Collection of methods for objects of class jfs.

p.adjust method for class "jfs" and "flipscores". Add adjusted p-values into the jfsand flipscores object.

Usage

p.adjust(object, method = "maxT", tail = 0, ...)

Arguments

object

an object of class jfs and flipscores.

method

any method implemented in flip.adjust or a custom function. In the last case it must be a function that uses a matrix as input and returns a vector of adjusted p-values equal to the number of columns of the inputed matrix.

tail

argument: expresses the tail direction of the alternative hypothesis. It can be "two.sided" (or 0, the default), "less" (or -1) or "greater" (or +1).

...

additional arguments to be passed
